title: Thoughts Without a Reporting Verb
goal: Recognise free indirect speech in a story: a character’s question, doubt or exclamation told in the narrator’s past tense.
grammar: Free indirect speech: recognising it in narration

items: I can spot free indirect speech in a story: a character’s question, doubt or exclamation told in the narrator’s past tense.
I can tell it apart from direct speech and from reported speech with a verb like pensó que.
I can use the new words for talking about narration.
